# Ultra Localized Demographic Data

Canadian census data offers precise insights for business decisions, but its complexity can be a hurdle. The MTM Census Tool is a user-friendly interactive dashboard that simplifies census data analysis, providing geography-based demographic information sourced directly from Statistics Canada.

[Request a Demo](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/en/request-demo/)

![MTM analytic tool dashboard](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/census-tool/Census-tool.webp)

[Watch Video](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/en/census-tool/demo/)

## Highlights

70,000+ Geographic Areas

Analyze audiences across 70,000+ Geographic Areas, by region, city, or postal area to pinpoint where media and tech trends emerge.

2,000+ Demographic Variables

Segment by 2,000+ Demographic Variables like age, gender, income, or language to reveal who’s driving adoption and change.

![Geographic filters preview](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/census-tool/census-geo-filters.webp)

![Demographic filters preview](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/census-tool/census-demo-filters.webp)

## Explore Census Tool Features

![Snapshot tool preview](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/census-tool/Snapshot-Tool.webp)

### Snapshot

Understand any region at a glance

Population, age, income, language, immigration, indigenous identity: Any Canadian geography in seconds.

What You Get

- Quick Insights

  Generate instant "Community Portraits" for any Canadian geography.

- Key Metrics

  Analyze population, age, income, and language in seconds.

- Data Exports

  Easily export data tables for quick analysis and sharing.

![Drilldown tool preview](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/census-tool/Drilldown-Tool.webp)

### Drilldown

Multi-dimensional targeting

Find exactly who you are looking for by combining up to three distinct characteristics simultaneously. Layer specific demographic filters to surface the precise communities your work is about and visualize their distribution across the map

What You Get

- Target Markets

  Find populations with the exact combination of characteristics you require.

- Visual Mapping

  Use interactive maps to visualize exactly where your target population lives

- Ranked Data

  Access characteristic distributions and ranked geographies for your selected segments.

63% 63% In Toronto, 63% of women aged 18-34 make less than $40,000/year

![Ranker tool preview](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/census-tool/Ranker-Tool.webp)

### Ranker

Identify target geographies in seconds

Eliminate the guesswork by ranking every geography in Canada against your specific business KPIs. Instantly identify geographies of interest.

What You Get

- Market Rankings

  Rank geographies based on any specific Census characteristic.

- Custom Criteria

  Rank markets by counts, percentages, medians, or averages.

- Filtered Selection

  Precision-target regions by filtering out irrelevant population sizes.

![Demographic Explorer tool preview](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/census-tool/Demo-Explorer-Tool.webp)

### Demographic Explorer

Deep-dive into any geography

Analyze any region through granular characteristic distributions. Move beyond surface-level statistics to evaluate the unique profiles of individuals, families, and households.

What You Get

- Characteristic Distributions

  View distributions of any characteristic in any Canadian geography.

- Multidimensional Data

  Access data on individuals, families, dwellings, and household types.

- Aggregate Statistics

  Explore averages and medians alongside distributions for thorough location understanding.

11% 11% of the labour force in Saskatchewan work in the primary sector (Sector 11: Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting, and Sector 21: Mining, Quarrying, and Oil and Gas Extraction), more than any other province

![Compare tool preview](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/census-tool/Compare-Tool.webp)

### Compare

Benchmark your target geography

Contextualize your regional data by contrasting local markets against provincial or national standards. Identify demographic gaps and outliers to to better understand you target market.

What You Get

- Market Benchmarking

  Compare a market against similar regions or national benchmarks.

- Visual Analysis

  Contrast characteristic distributions across different geographies using intuitive charts.

- Gap Identification

  Identify and understand demographic differences between specific territories.

![Canada Score tool preview](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/tools/census-tool/Canada-Score-Tool.webp)

### Canada Score

Data-driven scoring tailored to your strategy

Take control of your market analysis with advanced, multi-factor weighted modeling. Score and rank potential locations based on your custom persona clusters to find the best opportunities for your brand.

What You Get

- Strategic Alignment

  Align rankings to your strategy using weighted modeling and custom personas.

- Threshold Filtering

  Ensure only geographies meeting your specific business thresholds are considered.

- Infinite Combinations

  Access millions of characteristic combinations possible across four distinct dimensions.
